channel.title: Denis Baciu
channel.description: Writing on industrialising AI in financial services — taking proof-of-concepts into production.

item.title: Why I'd instrument before building an internal AI cluster
item.description: A practical look at Nutanix's $20M AI cluster and the build vs buy decision for heavy SaaS AI spend.

item.title: The coordination tax in a polyrepo estate
item.description: A polyrepo estate behaves like a distributed system, and recurring coordination work should drive the monorepo decision, not ideology.

item.title: Open-weight models are moving into production workloads
item.description: A practical look at evaluating open-weight models on real traffic, piloting them in low-risk tasks, and choosing managed inference.

item.title: Slack Code moves AI coding out of the terminal into group chat
item.description: Slack Code puts coding agents in shared channels so teams can prompt, review, and steer AI-generated changes with a searchable record.

item.title: Boring Infrastructure Sleeps Better
item.description: Rogue Amoeba's move from CGI to FastCGI and MySQL to SQLite shows how deliberately unglamorous upgrades can reduce operational pain and improve resilience.

item.title: Enterprise AI’s Quiet Shift from Experiments to Unit Economics
item.description: Enterprise AI adoption is moving from broad experimentation to disciplined, measurable use cases driven by cost observability and per-query ROI.

item.title: An LLM wiki is not a self-maintaining knowledge base
item.description: Casey Newton's LLM wiki shows real research gains but also ongoing maintenance, where curation is the real product.

item.title: MCP session handles are capability tokens, not pointers
item.description: MCP's shift to model-held session handles trades server affinity for horizontal scale; short-lived capability tokens keep both.

item.title: Why Regulated Enterprises Will Mix Open and Closed Models
item.description: Regulated enterprises will increasingly blend open-weight and closed models for AI agents, driven by control, auditability, and customization rather than benchmark scores.

item.title: Multi-cloud AI observability needs a common transponder
item.description: How OpenTelemetry and AWS AgentCore Observability can turn fragmented AI agent monitoring into one operational pane across clouds.

item.title: AI-assisted PostgreSQL migrations need a human review loop
item.description: Google Cloud's Gemini in Database Migration Service drafts PL/pgSQL conversions, but teams must keep a strict review loop to avoid subtle logic changes.

item.title: The Real Bottleneck in Data Platforms Is Neglected Orchestration
item.description: While tool sprawl gets the blame, the true problem is treating orchestration as a cron job instead of a control plane with SLOs for freshness, failure recovery, and cost.

item.title: Why I’d Bet on the Agent Access Model for Production
item.description: Cloudflare’s Agent Access Model authorizes each agent action at the task level, using short-lived credentials and a Trust Ratchet to eliminate privilege creep.

item.title: Memory is the bottleneck nobody budgets for
item.description: CXL memory pooling relieves GPU HBM constraints in RAG and vector search by offloading KV caches and embeddings to shared low-latency memory.

item.title: The enterprise AI strategy that outlasts any single model
item.description: An effective AI strategy abstracts providers, evaluates on real tasks, monitors costs and latency, and avoids vendor lock-in.

item.title: Agents Are Easy to Build, Hard to Control
item.description: Real-time observability and governance must be built into AI agents from day one, or organizations face black-box risks and spiraling costs.

item.title: Overprivileged AI Agents Repeat Old IAM Mistakes
item.description: 71% of organizations have AI agents that can reach sensitive data; one-third of developers saw incidents from overprivileged non-human identities.

item.title: Stateful Execution Is the Next Bottleneck for Enterprise AI Agents
item.description: Stateful execution environments are set to become the primary bottleneck for enterprise AI agents, with Perplexity’s SPACE as an early signal.

item.title: Observability Is a Safety Net, Not a Silver Bullet, for Vibe Coding
item.description: Observability exposes gaps in AI-generated code, but its feedback loop is slow; enforce contracts and use runtime data for targeted fixes.

item.title: Routine coding tasks don't need expensive reasoning models
item.description: Routine coding tasks don't need deep chain-of-thought, and using expensive models for them wastes money; a router sending simple prompts to cheap models solves that.
